problems.location: Materials and methods, Single-molecule rotation assay
problems.problem: Myosin is described as a 'reference standard in the calibration measurements' for a single-molecule rotation assay of a ring ATPase. Myosin is an actin-based motor protein and has no role in calibrating rotational mechanics or bead tracking in such assays; calibration typically relies on thermal fluctuation analysis (power spectrum) or known optical/magnetic trap stiffness.
